title: Reasoning task contagion: GSM-Hard with chat debate + source exit

notes: Chat mode on GSM-Hard math problems — active persuasion on reasoning tasks.
Contamination agent argues for the wrong answer in real-time debate.
Compare: source stays vs exits, fully-connected chat.
On familiar topics, chat reduced lock-in from 0.158 to 0.008.
On reasoning tasks, chat may be WORSE — active persuasion + no training knowledge to fall back on.
Directly tests the Deliberative Illusion anchoring-on-wrong-answer finding.
